reference.source: Independent fresh standalone official UMD pages. Public original controls/props/data/refs, real pointer/keyboard/wheel/native-scroll/scrollbar actions and ordinary controlled-owner updates. No Native code, expected geometry, Source patches or result normalization.
reference.protocol: Unchanged official controls, actual raw OptionType/FieldNames owner. String primitive value domain, explicit filter=false except declared producer scenes, public onSearch undefined while owner closed. Every selection/open/search/active/scroll callback retained; lossless tagged raw fields and property descriptors never invoke accessors. All producer calls remain raw, distinct actual semantic arguments collected upfront; no expected coordinates or Native reads.
